title: Allow authenticated users to create their own Firestore profile document

requirements.summary: Modify Firestore security rules to permit an authenticated user to create only their own profile document at users/{userId} (request.auth.uid == userId) without changing any other rules or app logic.
acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/firestore.rules`, the `match /users/{userId}` block includes an `allow create:` rule that evaluates to true only when the request is authenticated and `request.auth.uid == userId`.
After deploying the updated Firestore rules, a brand-new user completing signup can successfully write the profile document to `users/{auth.uid}` (no 'Missing or insufficient permissions' error).

Existing constraints remain unchanged: users cannot write other users' profile documents; admin/super_admin/helper_admin permissions and all other collection rules are not altered except as required to enable profile CREATE for self.

file_operations.description: Update (or confirm) the `match /users/{userId}` rules so `allow create` is permitted only for authenticated requests where `request.auth.uid == userId`, ensuring no other rule blocks self-create and without altering admin/helper or other collection rules.
